title: Do All Languages Cost the Same? Tokenization in the Era of Commercial Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing tokenization fragmentation rates across 22 typologically diverse languages using parallel corpora (FLORES-200) to measure disparities in sequence length, commercial API usage costs, and downstream task utility in few-shot in-context learning.

Correlating language-specific token fragmentation rates, API financial costs, and model utility (performance) with the Human Development Index (HDI) of the countries where the evaluated languages are primarily spoken.
